name: TAKT PROJECT
introduction: TAKT PROJECT is a design firm that advocates as a DESIGN THINK+DO TANK and develops a diverse selection of projects to create "another possibilities." Represented by Satoshi Yoshiizumi, the organization was established in 2013. They have been involved in the development of many varied projects with a wide range of clients, including start-ups, large enterprises, universities, research institutes, administrative agencies and more.They have conducted experimental independent research projects and have exhibited their conclusions at national and international art museums and design events such as Milano Salone, Maison et Objet Paris, and Hong Kong M+. Based on the research results, they features a unique approach to maximizing the role of design according to various clients and collaboration, projects. Principal Award History: Design Miami/ Swarovski Designers of the Future Award 2017, iF Design Award 2017, Red Dot Award 2016, and Good Design Award.
